name: at_risk_pipeline_report
when: Produce a report of at-risk deals from the CRM.
steps: Call crm.list_deals({}) without a stage filter to retrieve all deals, following 'next_cursor' until all deals are retrieved.
Filter deals where 'stage' is 'qualified', 'negotiation', 'proposal', or any other stage identified as 'OPEN' (i.e., not 'closed_won' or 'closed_lost').
For each OPEN deal, call crm.get_deal({'deal_id': deal['id']}) to get detailed information.
For each OPEN deal, call crm.get_notes({'deal_id': deal['id']}) to check for additional risk signals in the notes.

Identify 'at-risk' deals: those with 'health' 'R' (Red), or those with 'health' 'A' (Amber) or 'G' (Green) that have specific risk indicators in crm.get_deal or crm.get_notes. Do NOT consider 'Follow-up on security questionnaire' in notes as a risk indicator.
For each at-risk deal, call crm.get_owner({'owner_id': deal['owner']}).
If the owner is found and 'active' is true, use their 'name'; otherwise, use 'UNASSIGNED'.
Compile the report with deal_id, owner, and a short reason for being at risk.

name: Triage Open Issues
when: Triage open issues by assigning owner and priority label.
steps: Call tracker.list_issues with status='open' and paginate through all results to get all open issues.
Call tracker.list_labels to get available labels and their descriptions.
Call tracker.list_members to get members and their owned modules.
For each issue, extract the module from the title (e.g., '[module] title').
Determine the assignee: Find the member whose 'owns' list contains the extracted module. If no module is found or no member owns it, assign null.

Determine the priority label based on keywords in the title: 'Production outage' or 'sync is broken' -> 'sev-1'; '500 on save' -> 'sev-1'; 'Minor alignment issue' or 'Add dark-mode icon' -> 'sev-3'; otherwise, 'sev-2'.

Before assigning or labeling, check for potential duplicates: if an issue title is similar to another, call tracker.get_issue and tracker.list_comments for both issues to confirm if they are duplicates. If confirmed, apply 'duplicate' label and do not assign an owner.
Call tracker.assign_issue with the determined member_id (if not null) and tracker.add_label with the determined label for each issue.
Report the list of triaged issues with their assigned labels and assignees.

name: Triage Open Issues
when: New open issues need priority labels and owners.
steps: Call tracker.list_issues with status='open' and paginate to get all open issues.
Call tracker.list_labels to get available labels.
Call tracker.list_members to get available members and their ownerships.
For each issue:
Extract the module name from the title (e.g., '[module] Title').
Determine the assignee by matching the module name to a member's 'owns' field.
Call tracker.list_comments for the issue to check for 'duplicate of #X' or other relevant information.
If comments explicitly mark the issue as a duplicate, apply the 'duplicate' label and do not assign an owner.

Otherwise, determine the priority label based on keywords in the title (e.g., 'Production outage', 'All users cannot log in', 'Data loss' -> 'sev-1'; '500 on save', 'Export to CSV fails' -> 'sev-2'; 'Improve empty-state copy', 'Typo in settings tooltip' -> 'sev-3').
If not a duplicate, assign the determined owner and apply the determined priority label.
